Improved: The mod description now reads "An essential Fabric mod for MineBerry and MinePeak".
The Website button in Mod Menu now opens the new Modrinth page (modrinth.com/mod/mineberryessentials).
Removed: WorldEditCUI was removed from the mod.

New: Tournament HUD: add your friends by username and a box on your screen shows their last chat messages in full, and whether they are alive, dead or left, with an Alive count on top. Off by default, switch it on in the Tools tab.
Dead is read from the server's death and elimination lines and from spectator mode, never from player chat. Statuses start fresh when a round starts or you join a server.
Radial Menu: hold V and a pie menu opens around your crosshair with quick commands (/spawn, /tpa and /tpaccept). Move to a slice and let go of the key to run it.
It follows Tournament Mode and PvP Command Lock, so a blocked command stays blocked.
Improved: Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape now show a note when you switch them on: they work well, but can sometimes send /spawn when a friend teleports you to them (tpa).
Fixed: Fixed Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock turning on when the server announced that ANOTHER player left the game in PvP mode and was killed.
Fixed a player typing "entered pvp mode" (or similar) in chat switching on Safe Logout, PvP Command Lock and the abuse alert. Only the server's own messages count now.
Old configs are updated automatically: the PvP start pattern no longer matches every line that contains "PvP mode".

versions.title: Tournament Mode and PvP Command Lock

New: Tournament Mode: blocks every command so nobody gets teleported out of a tournament by accident. Off by default, switch it on in the Safety tab.
PvP Command Lock: while you're in PvP mode, only /r, /msg, /m and a few other chat commands work.
Safe Logout: an "I'm safe - unlock" button in the pause menu ends the guard right away.
Improved: Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock let go by themselves after 3 minutes if the server's "out of PvP mode" message is missed.
The "out of PvP mode" message is now also read from the action bar.

New: Screenshot: press F9 to take a screenshot and copy it to your clipboard as an image, ready to paste into Discord.
Screenshots tab: see your screenshots, copy or open any of them.
Chat Search: press F8 to search your chat history. Copy any line with one click.
Improved: Safe Logout now follows the server's PvP mode messages instead of a 30 second timer.
Fixed: Safe Logout no longer re-enters combat after the server says you're out of PvP mode.
Keybind names now show properly in the controls menu.

versions.title: New HUD modules and Safe Logout

New: Five new HUD modules: Keystrokes / CPS, Armor Status, Potion Effects, Compass and Biome / Time. They are off by default, turn them on from their cards.
Safe Logout: quitting is guarded for 30 seconds after combat, so you can't leave a fight by accident.
Improved: The HUD menu has < > page buttons (or use the mouse wheel) when there are more modules than fit.
When a screen corner is full, the next HUD modules start a second column instead of going off screen.
Fixed: Fixes for Minecraft 26.2 (Safe Logout and the pause menu guard).

New: A Check for updates button in the Tools tab. It works even if automatic checking is turned off.
Improved: The update checker no longer depends on GitHub's rate-limited API, so it keeps working on shared networks.

New: A What's New popup now opens once on the title screen after you update the mod.
Control Center > Tools has a What's New button to read the notes again any time.
Improved: If you skipped a few versions, the notes of every version you missed are listed together.
